Overview

Summarise what the business does, their industry, key challenges, employee count, current bank, and where they operate. Include website URL if available.

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
Money In

Outline how the business receives payments. Include trade terms (e.g. 30 days EOM), current receivables channels, any new ones they’re exploring (e.g. Direct Debit, BPAY), and Cash / Cheque requirements. Note if a Worldline referral is relevant

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
Money Held

List the number and type of accounts (CAP or Cache) FCA, including average balances. Explain the rationale behind the current or proposed structure. Note any overdraft needs (include amount if applicable). Highlight what matters most to the customer (e.g. low cost, fewer accounts). Include a brief overview of the corporate structure relevant to the account setup.

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
Money Out

List all payment methods (e.g. cards, cheques, cash) and volumes (paper, DE, international, etc.—see appendix). Note card needs (type/features), supplier locations, and petty cash handling.

Fileactive Checklist

A fundamental aspect of ANZ’s Code of Conduct and the regulatory environment that we operate in, is products, offering Fileactive Host to Host as part of any proposal may only be done by suitability qualified people that understand the service and only where it has been determined suitable for a customer. Suitability is qualified by knowing your customer and determining that the customer would materially benefit from the service, are suitable for using the service by having the technical resources required and are willing to invest the time and money required to use the service.

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
Qualifying the Benefit (check the appropriate response)

On average, does the customer only use Internet Banking for 5 minutes a day to download statements, and 15 -30 minutes per week to send payroll or accounts payable?


Yes. Saving this nominal amount of time will not benefit the customer, because the effort to implement and support Secure File Transfer infrastructure will outweigh any benefits realisation. Recommend the use of Transactive or an Internet Banking channel.


No. There are material customer benefits in both time and audit controls to introduce Straight Through Processing (STP) - Proceed to the next criteria

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
Technical sophistication is likely present (check the appropriate response)

Does the customer have a high degree of technical sophistication that includes a team of technical resources that operate their computer network, server environment and applications?


Yes. The customer has a dedicated technology team, where we can verify the technical requirements will be met post proposing the solution - Proceed to the next criteria.


No. Where a customer does not have dedicated technical teams or outsources their technical team on an ‘as needs’ support basis, then Fileactive will be unsuitable for the customer as it needs specialist technology resources to establish and provide ongoing technical support for. Recommend the use of Transactive or Internet Banking channel

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
Does the customer utilise an enterprise grade finance system such as SAP, Oracle, JD Edwards, Microsoft Dynamix? (check the appropriate response)

Yes - Proceed to the next criteria


﻿No - (Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks), refer the customer to their Accounting Service Provider as they (the service provider) receive the data direct from ANZ - Fileactive is not suitable. Recommend the use of Transactive or an Internet Banking channel

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
Does the customer have technology staff within the business to provide the following resources to the Fileactive implementation project? (check the appropriate response)

Project Manager - to co-ordinate the tasks required within your environment across the domains listed below. This role may also track issues or changes and address these to the relevant people.


Infrastructure Team - to consider how files that are to be exchanged with ANZ will move between the TMS/ERP/Finance system, the external facing File Transfer infrastructure and ANZ Fileactive. Internal network shares may need to be created along with scripts to automate the transfer of data. This team may have input into the Fileactive Configuration Form and File Exchange Matrix to select naming conventions and transport or security methods.


Network Team - may be one and the same as the infrastructure team. May need to complete firewall changes to allow the selected file transfer methods to reach the ANZ infrastructure. They will need to populate the Fileactive Configuration form with IP addressing details.


Financial System Application Support Team (SAP, Oracle, JDE, etc.) - personnel with the responsibility of the relevant finance system may need to:

  1. Obtain and Configure Vendor Data to fulfil payments instructions
  2. Configure bank reconciliation modules to consume Bank Statement data and Receivables data.
  3. Analysis of File Format and Samples to be exchanged
  4. Enable the exporting and importing of data and exchanged with ANZ

Test Analyst - resources tasked with testing the integration with ANZ & will need to consider what appropriate test cases should be conducted and execute and record results of tests during the testing phases.



Yes - Proceed to Implementation where the customer has agreed to associated fees and made available the above technical resources to implement the service﻿


No - Fileactive is unsuitable as these resources are necessary for both implementation and ongoing support activities on the customer side. Recommend the use of Transactive or an Internet Banking channel

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
Qualifying customer investment in adopting the service (check the appropriate response)

Qualifying the Customer appetite to incur both their costs for the service and ANZ fees: Is the customer likely to agree to pay the AU$5,000 (excl. GST) implementation charge for Fileactive Host to Host (the cost of Fileactive Translation and Workflow functionality will be determined during scoping but will be a minimum of $5,000 excl. GST), and AU$150 (excl. GST) monthly charge as well as greater internal costs to implement and support the service, in order to realise the benefit?


Yes. Benefits realisation will support this cost that the customer will agree to pay and incur by way of their technical resources needing to implement and support the service. Outcome: Fileactive Host to Host is likely to benefit the customer


No. The ANZ cost to implement Fileactive for each customer exceeds the $3500 charge in fixed costs. It is not commercially viable to offer Fileactive where a customer is not agreeable to the establishment and ongoing charges. Outcome: Recommend the use of Transactive or an Internet Banking channel
